jobs.occupation: Contract Manager & Technical Sales Specialist in Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Maersk H2S Safety Services is seeking a Contract Manager & Technical Sales Specialist to support our global commercial activities.

The role combines contract management, tender execution, and technical sales support, helping drive opportunities from initial inquiry through contract award and ongoing customer engagement.

Working closely with sales, operations, and technical teams, you will manage commercial risks, prepare competitive proposals, and develop customer-focused solutions for clients operating in demanding industrial environments.

We Offer

Maersk H2S Safety Services is a global provider of gas safety and HSE services operating across the energy, offshore, maritime, and industrial sectors.

You will join a dynamic international team and play a key role in securing new business, supporting customers, and managing commercial agreements. The position offers significant exposure to customers worldwide and the opportunity to influence both commercial strategy and business growth.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Preparation and review of customer and supplier contracts.

• 
Identify and manage contractual, commercial, and operational risks.

• 
Coordinate and prepare tender submissions, commercial proposals, and pricing models.

• 
Work with technical and operational teams to develop customer-focused solutions.

• 
Support customer meetings, contract negotiations, and bid clarification sessions.

• 
Maintain contract records and ensure compliance with contractual obligations.

• 
Build strong customer relationships and support business development activities.

• 
Identify opportunities to improve commercial processes and win rates

Who we are looking for

You have experience from commercial roles, preferably within the oil & gas industry, and are comfortable dealing directly with customers and other stakeholders. We’re looking for someone who is commercially minded, takes ownership, and is willing to take responsibility.

• 
Experience from commercial roles

• 
Background in safety services, oil & gas, maritime, or similar sectors

• 
Clear and confident stakeholder management and communication skills

• 
Structured, pragmatic, and results-oriented approach to your work

• 
Ability to work independently and as part of a team

• 
Willingness to travel (approximately 20 days per year)

• 
Fluent in English

Work location: Esbjerg, Denmark.

Are you ready to make an impact?

If you are passionate about driving commercial impact, particularly within safety and industrial services, we want to hear from you. Join Maersk H2S Safety Services and use your industry experience and commercial skills to help grow our business.

jobs.occupation: SPAR NORD ARENA SØGER BY BANEFORVALTER
jobs.description:
Spar Nord Arena - Aalborg Væddeløbsbane SØGER NY BANEFORVALTER

Da vores nuværende baneforvalter ønsker at gå ned i tid, søger vi en ny til at afløse ham.

Spar Nord Arena – Aalborg Væddeløbsbane er med 40 årlige løbsdage Danmarks mest aktive væddeløbsbane. Vi afvikler både trav- og galopløb på vores 18 ha. store område, og som baneforvalter får du ansvaret for at både vores baner og vores område spiller til såvel løb som træning. Stillingen er fuld tid, og vores nye baneforvalter skal i tæt samarbejde med ledelsen og tre kollegaer der hjælper med at passe bane og område, sikre at vi opretholder et højt niveau på vores sportslige faciliteter og omgivelser.

Dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver bliver:

·At passe opvisnings- og træningsbaner.

·At foretage reparationer / vedligehold på maskiner og bygninger.

·At passe vores grønne område.

·Øvrigt forefaldende arbejde.

Din profil: Vi lægger vægt på at du har erfaring med traktorer, redskaber og maskiner i almindelighed. Du må gerne have hænderne skruet rigtigt på, så du uden problemer kan udføre løbende reparationer.

Indgangsvinklen til jobbet kan f.eks. være maskinfører, landmand, greenkeeper, vicevært, banemand eller aktiv udøver.

Da vores løb afvikles når andre har fri (aften og/eller weekend), er det et krav, at du kan arbejde på disse dage.

Vi tilbyder: Et godt og stabilt job med frihed under ansvar. En løn som matcher dine kvalifikationer.

Vi ønsker stillingen besat hurtigst muligt, men vi venter gerne på den rette. Da vi afholder samtaler løbende, opfordrer vi dig til at søge stillingen hellere i dag end i morgen.

For yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kontakt banechef Lars Hellerup.

jobs.occupation: Master Planner - Processed Production
jobs.description:
Do you want to play an important role in ensuring an efficient and flexible supply chain across our food processing factories? Are you able to navigate in a complex stakeholder landscape where totality is one of the essential key words? Would you like to join a team in development and help shape the direction of the future work? Then this position may be interesting to you.

About the job

We are looking for a dedicated and structured Master Planner to join our Processed Production team at the head office in Randers. We are an area in development, which means you’ll have a unique opportunity to shape the role and influence how we work going forward. You will play a key role in planning and coordinating production across our sites in Denmark, Germany and The Netherlands – with a focus on forecasting, capacity utilization, and network optimization.

Your key responsibilities are:

• Act as the central link between factory planners and demand planning to align production plans with demand forecasts.

• Consolidate capacity data from multiple sites and translate it into actionable production strategies.

• Be a key contributor in S&OE and S&OP forums to align operational execution with long-term strategic goals.

• Identify and resolve planning bottlenecks by balancing production loads across sites.

• Develop and maintain tools, such as capacity overviews, to enhance transparency and inform decision-making.

• Drive continuous improvement in planning processes, including network optimization and implementing best practices.

• Facilitate structured collaboration across departments to ensure alignment on priorities and constraints.

• Conduct scenario planning to model different production and supply chain outcomes and proactively mitigate risks such as raw material shortages or demand fluctuations.

• Leverage analytics and KPIs to support data-driven decision-making and improve planning accuracy and responsiveness.

• Maintain a strong understanding of the end-to-end supply chain, from raw material sourcing to finished goods delivery.

You take ownership of your projects

We seek a self-driven Master Planner to lead planning initiatives and enhance value by leveraging scale across our production network. You will oversee analysis, coordination, and implementation of improvements in your planning areas. A structured approach and stakeholder engagement are essential for ensuring alignment and commitment to solutions and changes.

Your ability to establish collaboration both inside and around your planning responsibilities and to influence functional teams throughout the organization is key for success in this role. Therefore, it is important that you can navigate and thrive in a complex stakeholder landscape, and that you apply your interpersonal skills to create meaningful relationships across the group.

The ideal candidate would:

• Have a relevant B.Sc or M.Sc degree within supply chain OR a strong background in supply chain management & planning, preferably within the food or manufacturing industry.

• Be skilled at translating complex data into clear, actionable plans and recommendations.

• A solid understanding of the end-to-end supply chain and how planning decisions impact each stage.

• Be Confidence working with Microsoft 365, particularly excel. Experience with planning systems (e.g. SAP APO, IBP, or similar) is considered an advantage.

• Be proactive and structured, with a natural ability to anticipate challenges and drive alignment across stakeholders.

• Thrive in a dynamic environment where priorities shift and collaboration across functions is key.

• Be fluent in Danish and English — knowledge of German is considered an advantage.

Appetite for more?

We are writing the next chapter for planning at Danish Crown and invite you to be part of it.

Please do not hesitate to contact Manager, Planning & Supply Chain Kamilla Hellerup, phone: +45 29893293 to learn more about the position.

We review candidates continuously, so send your CV and a few words on why you are a candidate to consider as soon as possible, as we reserve the right to stop the search once we have found the right candidate.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Product Specialist
jobs.description:
**The Impact You'll Make

**Do you want to work at the intersection of technology, customers and product management, helping ensure that sensing products remain competitive, commercially attractive and easy to sell throughout their lifecycle?

Danfoss Sensing Solutions, part of Danfoss Climate Solutions, is looking for a Product Specialist to join our Application & Product Support organization. In this role, you will combine technical product knowledge with operational product management, supporting the day-to-day management of our sensor portfolio and ensuring that product data, documentation, pricing and commercial information are accurate and available to the organization.

You will work closely with Product Management, Sales, Engineering and Supply Chain. You will help turn decisions into practical implementation, coordinate activities across functions, and ensure that released products are properly maintained throughout their lifecycle.

The role offers an opportunity to build a broad understanding of sensing technologies, applications and commercial product management in an international organization.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**Your responsibilities will include:

• Support Product Management in the day-to-day coordination of the sensor portfolio, helping maintain released products throughout their lifecycle and coordinating practical activities related to product introductions, product changes, phase-outs and other portfolio updates

• Maintain product master data, technical documentation, sales literature and pricing information, ensuring accuracy, consistency and availability across the organization

• Coordinate evaluations of new product variants and customer requests, driving implementation across Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Operations and Supply Chain

• Act as a trusted product and application expert for internal stakeholders, supporting technical evaluations, product selection, customer interactions and training activities

• Drive coordination and continuous improvement activities that strengthen collaboration, simplify processes and improve product information quality across the organization

**What We're Looking For

**You are structured, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of operational tasks. You enjoy working with both technical and commercial topics and understand the importance of accuracy, timely follow-up and clear communication.

**In Addition, We Expect That

**

• You hold a degree in Engineering, Business Engineering or a related technical or commercial field and have experience from product support, product management, engineering, sales support or a similar role within a technical organization

• A genuine interest in sensing technologies and their applications is a strong plus. Experience with pressure, temperature or other sensing technologies is advantageous

• You understand, or are motivated to learn, the commercial and operational aspects of managing technical products throughout their lifecycle

• You are comfortable working with product data, technical documentation, pricing information and structured processes, bringing strong analytical and organizational skills.

• You have proven ability to coordinate activities across multiple stakeholders and functions, ensuring timely implementation and follow-through

• You are a proactive and service-oriented professional who builds strong relationships and understands that success comes from enabling teams across Danfoss to deliver results together. You are fluent in English, both spoken and written

Experience with product information management, ERP systems, master data, lifecycle management or technical documentation would be an advantage, but it is not a requirement.

**What You'll Get From Us

**You will join an experienced and collaborative organization where technical knowledge, product understanding and customer needs come together. You will have the opportunity to develop your knowledge of sensing technologies while gaining practical experience with operational product management and global product lifecycle processes.

We promote development from within and support learning through collaboration, mentoring, training and access to global opportunities.

You will have flexibility, autonomy and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. We strive to create an inclusive working environment where people of different backgrounds and perspectives are respected and valued.

Benefits may include annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance and other locally applicable benefits.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you!

Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

For information about the position, please contact, Director, Application & Product Support Christian Dall Larsen, +45 2966 7369

For information about the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner, Gerd Veierskov, +45 3057 1882

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

Experience with a platform such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze, Adobe, Agillic, Voyado, Bloomreach or Klaviyo.

jobs.occupation: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
Shape the future of education technology

At IST, we're building the cloud platform that powers educational solutions used by more than five million users across Europe. Unlike most cloud teams, we run our own cloud — on our own hardware, in our own data center. That means the abstraction stops with us: when a node misbehaves, there's no support ticket to a hyperscaler.

There's a rack, and someone who knows it.

We're looking for a Cloud Engineer who finds that appealing rather than daunting.

About the role

As a Cloud Engineer, you'll help design, build and operate the IST Cloud Platform — from the automation and orchestration layers our developers build on, all the way down to the switches, servers and cabling that carry it. You'll do this together with our Cloud Engineering team, architects, developers and stakeholders, whether the work happens at a keyboard or in a rack.

In practice, around a quarter of your time will be spent physically on site in the data center. Not as a separate duty, but as a natural part of the work: expanding capacity for a new cluster the team has just automated, replacing a switch that's been throwing errors in your own monitoring, tracing a network issue that turns out to be a cable rather than a config. Owning the platform end to end is what makes this role different from a pure cloud position.

The role is based at our office in Roskilde, Denmark, with the primary data center within reach. Some travel is required, primarily to our office in Växjö, Sweden.

Key responsibilities

• Design, build and operate the IST Cloud Platform across the full stack — from physical hardware to the self-service tooling our developers use

• Automate VMs, containers, storage and networking using Ansible, Terraform, Puppet and PowerShell DSC

• Plan and carry out capacity expansions: from sizing and procurement to racking, cabling, provisioning and putting the capacity into production

• Diagnose and resolve issues wherever they originate — including replacing switches, disks and other failed components on site, and handling firmware, BIOS and driver lifecycle across the fleet

• Support reliable, scalable developer platforms, CI/CD pipelines, orchestration and self-service tools

• Manage databases, object storage and monitoring/logging stacks, with observability that spans both the platform and the hardware underneath it

• Contribute to access, identity and compliance work in line with ISO, PCI and internal policies, including physical access and site security

• Ensure robust backup and disaster recovery plans are in place, tested against real hardware failure scenarios

• Coordinate with hardware vendors and support partners (Dell, Cisco and similar) on spare parts, RMAs and escalations

Your profile

You have a bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, network engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, along with solid experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure automation and DevOps practices.

Just as importantly, you're comfortable at both ends of the stack. You can discuss platform architecture with our developers in the morning and spend the afternoon in the rack with a screwdriver, and you see those as the same job rather than two different ones. Working in a data center environment — noisy, cold, occasionally at short notice — is something you take in stride.

We also look for:

• Hands-on experience with server, storage and network hardware — Cisco, Dell, KVM, VMware or similar

• Practical understanding of data center fundamentals: power, cooling, rack design, structured cabling

• Strong knowledge of security, compliance and governance in cloud environments

• Strategic thinking and the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

• A collaborative, decisive and pragmatic approach to problem-solving

• A valid driver's license and the ability to reach the data center when needed

What we offer

This is a full-time, permanent position. We apply an office-first policy, and given the hands-on nature of this role, regular physical presence at the office and in the datacenter is part of the job. Within that framework, there's room for flexibility on the days where your work doesn't require you on site.

You'll join an international and collaborative environment where you'll have real ownership, influence over strategic technology decisions, and the chance to help shape the future of learning.

Apply

Applications are reviewed continuously. For questions, contact Bengt Welin bengt.welin@ist.com or HR@ist.com. Please note that a background check is part of the recruitment process.

Welcome to apply!

jobs.occupation: PhD Scholarship in Machine Learning for Non-Stationary and Non-Static Nano-Tomography - DTU Compute
jobs.description:
Recent advances in machine learning and deep learning are opening new possibilities for computational imaging, including the reconstruction of complex 3D structures from experimental imaging data. In this fully funded PhD project at DTU Compute, you will develop novel learning-based methods for X-ray nano-tomography. As state-of-the-art synchrotron imaging systems push towards ever higher spatial resolution, even minute positioning errors, mechanical drift, and sample deformations become sources of image degradation. The central challenge is to reconstruct accurate 3D and 4D representations of samples while accounting for positional uncertainties during image acquisition and changes in sample shape over time.

The project will bring together neural representations, inverse problems, geometric modeling, and computational imaging to address fundamental challenges in nano-tomography. Rather than correcting acquisition errors and sample deformations as separate preprocessing steps, you will investigate how to model and estimate the sample structure, acquisition geometry, and deformation jointly from the measured data.

The position is based at DTU Compute and conducted in close collaboration with EPFL and the Paul Scherrer Institute (PSI) in Switzerland, one of the leading centers for synchrotron X-ray imaging. As a PhD student, you will work in an international research environment spanning DTU, EPFL, and PSI, combining expertise in both machine learning and computational imaging with access to experimental data and advanced imaging facilities. Research visits to Switzerland are planned as part of the project.

Responsibilities

• Develop novel machine learning and deep learning methods for X-ray nano-tomography, which jointly reconstruct sample structure, acquisition geometry, and deformation fields from inconsistent projection data.
• Investigate neural field representations for 3D and 4D imaging, including models that capture changes in sample geometry over time, and explore hybrid approaches combining learning-based methods with physical models of image formation and tomographic reconstruction.
• Validate and evaluate the developed methods using experimental nano-tomography data, initially focusing on integrated circuits.
• Collaborate with researchers at DTU, PSI, and EPFL, and participate in international research visits and scientific activities.
• Publish research results in leading journals and conferences in machine learning, computer vision, and computational imaging.
• Contribute to research-based teaching and supervision of MSc and BSc student projects.
• Participate in activities within the Center for Quantification of Imaging Data from MAX IV (QIM), including workshops, training courses, and interdisciplinary research collaborations.
Qualifications
You are curious and motivated by developing new machine learning methods to solve challenging problems in computational imaging. A strong background in machine learning and deep learning is particularly important. We welcome candidates from computer science, applied mathematics, physics, engineering, and related disciplines who are interested in combining modern learning methods with mathematical modeling and real-world experimental data. The candidate should be able to work independently, contribute effectively to an interdisciplinary research team, and communicate scientific ideas clearly in written and spoken English.

To succeed in this position, you are expected to have:

• A master's degree in computer science, applied mathematics, physics, engineering, or a related discipline.
• A strong background in machine learning and deep learning, including experience developing, implementing, or evaluating learning-based models.
• Experience with scientific programming, preferably in Python, and familiarity with relevant machine learning frameworks.
• A solid understanding of mathematical modeling, optimization, or numerical methods.
Experience in one or more of the following areas is an advantage:

• Neural representations, implicit neural fields, or other coordinate-based representations.
• Computer vision, 3D vision, geometric modeling, or structure-from-motion.
• Inverse problems, image reconstruction, or physics-informed machine learning.
• Image registration, motion estimation, or deformable modeling.
• Image processing, image analysis, or tomographic reconstruction.
• Knowledge of X-ray imaging and tomography is beneficial but not required. 
You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

At DTU Compute, we have a large focus on creating a good working environment. Our work with diversity and inclusion is an essential part of that. We believe that having a good working environment is a necessary foundation to provide excellent research, teaching, supervision and innovation.

At DTU Compute, we have about 140 PhD students. We offer several events and activities for all our PhD students such as annual PhD Bazaar, onboarding course where you will meet other PhD students, and you can join our PhD Club that organizes BBQs, board games events, lunches etc. 

Salary and appointment terms 
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures. 

The period of employment is 3 years. The starting date is 1 March 2027 (or according to mutual agreement). The position is a full-time position.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information 
Further information may be obtained from Hans Martin Kjer, hmkj@dtu.dk. 

You can read more about DTU Compute at www.compute.dtu.dk.

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 16 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Compute
DTU Compute – Department of Applied Mathematics and Computer Science – is an internationally recognised academic environment with over 400 employees and 10 research sections. We broadly cover digital technologies within mathematics, data science, computer science, and computer engineering, including artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, internet of things (IoT), chip design, cybersecurity, human-computer interaction, social networks, fairness, and data ethics. Our research is rooted in basic research and centres on mathematical models of the physical and virtual world, as a basis for the analysis, design, and implementation of complex systems. We focus on ensuring that our research results contribute to creating a better society by supporting areas such as health, green transition, energy supply, and life science. We collaborate with universities, public and private organisations, and companies in Denmark and abroad, and through DTU’s startup ecosystem, we encourage innovation and entrepreneurship. We have a strong ethical, human, and sustainable approach that ensures integrity in our work. Therefore, we strive for and take responsibility for driving the democratisation of digital technologies, so that everyone has the opportunity to actively participate in the development, and we ensure a continued open, democratic, and inclusive society for the benefit of all. At DTU Compute, we value diversity, inclusion, and a flexible work-life balance. Read more here: www.compute.dtu.dk.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.
